build_ms_marco_data: build the MS MARCO dataset by calling the build function to download and prepare data files
create_passage_teacher: create a PassageTeacher instance to handle passage selection tasks using the FbDeprecatedDialogTeacher base class
create_default_teacher: create a DefaultTeacher instance to handle question answering on MS MARCO data with context passages
review_setup_data_generator: review the DefaultTeacher setup_data method that yields context-question pairs with answers from JSON lines
summarize_path_function: summarize the _path function that resolves data file paths for train, valid, or test splits
